scope: Bounded unauthenticated Yandex Music metadata search from the actual Pletina Pages origin, with normal browser security and credentials omitted. VK Music is a primary-source session-dependency review only. No protected audio endpoints, login, scraping, signatures, keys, SDK installation, proxy, runtime server, or product changes.

yandexSourceReview.search: SearchMixin.search builds GET /search with text, type and page parameters. The per-method implementation does not explicitly require a token; runtime anonymous browser support is tested separately.
yandexSourceReview.audio: tracks_file_info documents that authorization is required; lossless requires a subscription. This probe does not call /get-file-info or /download-info and does not construct signatures or obtain media URLs.

vkSourceReview.finding: The reviewed VkAudio client depends on the supplied VkApi session: it obtains the current user ID via users.get, stores the session in self._vk, initializes cookies and performs audio search through self._vk.http.post to /al_audio.php with owner_id=self.user_id. This source does not establish an account-free full-audio browser route. No login, scraping, session reuse, or borrowed keys was attempted.
